scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist,dist/src,dist/assets,dist/assets/culture,dist/assets/shop,dist/assets/garden,dist/assets/characters,dist/assets/characters/sakura,dist/assets/characters/kohaku | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html dist/index.html -Force; Copy-Item src/*.js,src/*.css dist/src/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/*.webp dist/assets/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/culture/*.webp dist/assets/culture/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/shop/*.webp dist/assets/shop/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/garden/*.png,assets/garden/*.webp dist/assets/garden/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/characters/sakura/*.webp dist/assets/characters/sakura/ -Force; Copy-Item assets/characters/kohaku/*.webp dist/assets/characters/kohaku/ -Force"
